query: SELECT b.after_hours AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM businesses.emergency_switch s JOIN businesses.team_member m ON m.id = s.member_id AND m.business_id = s.business_id WHERE s.business_id = b.id AND s.member_id <> $2 AND s.switch_on AND s.yes_at IS NOT NULL AND m.removed_at IS NULL AND m.confirm_and_billing) AS "w!" FROM businesses.business b WHERE b.id = $1
